verdict.rationale: Ledgy is a SaaS equity-management platform with an API, so a webhooks story is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only OAuth service-account authentication and pull-based query operations. The closest item is delta retrieval of changed rows since an earlier request, which is polling rather than registrable outbound HTTP callbacks, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
